decisions.reason: Given the firm's public commitment and sunk investment in this core fouling detection automation, escalation of commitment leads management to persist despite possibly disappointing early results.

Although the web tool is less central to the machinery core, the firm has invested and publicized it, so escalation of commitment still favors keeping it, but with a slightly higher drop probability due to lower centrality.
Similar to A, the fouling detection system represents a central investment with public commitment, so management is likely to continue it under escalation of commitment.
